about: Two more cells of the Fairy type's chart, in play (fairy_chart.json has Dragon's two): a level-40 Clefairy uses Splash while a forced wild Magnemite, Electric and Steel, left only Poison Sting, hits it super effectively -- Poison against Fairy -- then hits the Magnemite with Moonblast, not very effective -- Fairy against Steel. Both sides' moves taught in the battle. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Magnemite used Poison Sting!
